description: Adds to one of the user's photos, keeping its scene, framing and light, paid from their credits, exactly one of: the main subject of another of their photos (with_photo_id: an object or a person, a cutout works well), which may not be a selfie nor photo_id itself; or one of their characters (with_character), made from that character's selfies and dressed for the scene, who may not be the one the photo is of. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.

with_character.description: The character to add, by its id or name from list_characters.

name: combine
title: Add to a photo from another photo or a character
